subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings expose filesystem metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should those entries stay hidden/neutral and be fixed through boundary-preserving UI semantics?
rationale: The unresolved false-Missing fix can be solved several ways, but one proposed path changes the gateway file metadata boundary; automation cannot choose that product/security tradeoff safely.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the UI/backend fix avoids raw filesystem stat disclosure outside the workspace boundary.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The gateway may return existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths, but only with explicit maintainer approval, tests, and documented boundary semantics.

options.title: Split Layout From File Semantics
options.body: Land or keep the already-merged layout repair separately while leaving false-Missing semantics blocked on the boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the UI/backend fix avoids raw filesystem stat disclosure outside the workspace boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and file preview work makes this the strongest available owner for the fs-safe metadata boundary decision.
